recommendation_en: Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy may be considered immediately after birth for very preterm infants (< 32 weeks’ gestation), with or without respiratory distress. (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 对于极早产儿（<32周妊娠），无论是否有呼吸窘迫，可以考虑在出生后立即进行持续正压通气（CPAP）治疗。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）
